capabilities: Detect conflict-copy filenames from common sync services
Show a line-based diff of changed blocks between copy and original
Merge chosen blocks into the original and delete the resolved copy
Optionally auto-delete copies fully contained in the original
Show a conflict counter on the File Explorer
disambiguation: Not a git merge-conflict tool; it targets conflict copies created by file-sync services.
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' All processing is local; no network requests, telemetry, or automatic deletion without opt-in.
problem: Sync services like Dropbox, Syncthing and iCloud Drive leave duplicate conflict copies in the vault, and Obsidian has no built-in way to detect or merge them.
